welcome_page.title: Cycling – Your trips
welcome_page.image_alt: #Bicycle and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
A few questions about getting around by bike or e-bike, including shared bikes. If you rarely cycle, we only ask why.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get around at least once a week?
questions.help: Your own bike or a shared one. Rides just for sport count too.

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Why do you rarely cycle? (Select all that apply)

options.text: I don't have a bike or e-bike I can use
The places I go are too far or cycling takes too long
Cycling is tiring or physically difficult for me
I feel unsafe cycling (traffic, crime or harassment)
There are no good cycle lanes or safe places to leave a bike
Another reason

questions.text: Which bike do you use most often?

options.text: My own bike
My own e-bike
A shared bike
A shared e-bike
A cargo bike or an adapted bike (e.g. tricycle, handbike)

questions.text: How confident do you feel cycling in city traffic?

options.text: Not at all: I avoid cycling in traffic
Not very: I cycle in traffic only when I have to
In between
Fairly: I manage most situations
Very: I cycle in any traffic
I never cycle in traffic

questions.text: Does cycling in your daily life help your health or your mood?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: In the same trip, do you usually combine cycling with another way of travelling?
questions.help: For example bike and train, or car and metro. A short walk to a stop or to a parked vehicle does not count.

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: Which other ways of travelling do you use in the same trip? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Walking (as the main mode for most of the trip, not short access or transfer walking)
Car
Car sharing
Motorcycle, scooter or moped
Bus
Tram
Metro
Regional or suburban train
e-scooter (private)
e-scooter (shared)

questions.text: What difficulties do you experience when combining different transport modes (e.g. bike + public transport, car + metro, walking + bus)?

options.text: Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space for a bicycle or luggage)
Poor coordination between modes (long waiting times, missed connections)
Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle parking or no bicycle access on public transport)
Complicated transfers (stations far apart, unclear routes)
Travel time becomes too long
Cost is too high when combining modes
Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe areas)
Services are infrequent or do not run in the evening
Lack of reliable information (schedules, delays)
Physical effort is too high (e.g. carrying a bicycle or walking long distances)
Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevators, etc.)

I do not experience significant difficulties

questions.text: When you face these difficulties, how do you mostly respond?

options.text: I stop using one of the modes (e.g. stop bringing my bike)
I switch to a single mode (e.g. only car, only public transport)
I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid peak hours)
I change the route or transfer point
I choose a different combination of modes
I continue using the same combination despite difficulties
I reduce how often I make that trip
I look for alternative solutions (e.g. bike sharing instead of own bike)
I avoid that trip entirely if possible
I do not experience significant difficulties

it.#<p>A few questions about getting around:
Alcune domande sugli spostamenti in bici o e-bike, anche in sharing. Se vai poco in bici, ti chiediamo solo perché.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Quelques questions sur vos déplacements à vélo ou à vélo électrique, y compris en libre-service. Si vous faites rarement du vélo, nous vous demandons seulement pourquoi.
